2. Heard Sri Neeraj Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Raj Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant- Prafull Singh with the prayer to allow this application and quash the entire proceeding as well as charge-sheet dated 13.12.2019 & cognizance order dated 10.07.2020 in Case No. 2778 of 2020 (State Vs. Prafull Singh)
arising out of Case Crime No. 192 of 2019, under Sections 419, 420 I.P.C., Police Station Devgaon,
District Azamgarh pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Court No.10, Azamgarh with a further prayer that proceeding of the aforesaid case be stayed against the applicant during the pendency of the present application.
4. After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press prayers made in the instant application and states that Prafull Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38685970/
1 the applicant is ready to surrender before the concerned trial court and seek his bail and that his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773.
5.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the State states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears / surrenders before the concerned trial court within three weeks from today and seek bail, his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
7. With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
